value.rationale: A natural and practically relevant two-dimensional periodic network with directional unit costs admits a complete global budget-optimal design rule. The direction ratio has an explicit logarithmically slow finite-size correction, beyond the standard unweighted torus logarithmic law. The sharp optimal-resistance constant and improvement factor over equal conductance give an interpretable size/price sensitivity rather than an arbitrary numeric invariant.
